crossRefs.note: It shall happen, that in whatever tribe the stranger lives, there you shall give him his inheritance,” says the Lord…

translations.web: It shall happen, that in whatever tribe the stranger lives, there you shall give him his inheritance,” says the Lord Yahweh.
translations.bsb: In whatever tribe a foreigner dwells, you are to assign his inheritance there,” declares the Lord GOD.
translations.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that in what tribe the stranger sojourneth, there shall ye give him his inheritance, saith the Lord GOD.
translations.asv: And it shall come to pass, that in what tribe the stranger sojourneth, there shall ye give him his inheritance, saith the Lord Jehovah.
